ledger.x: 1299: 'Duke Władysław I the Elbow-high had to cede Sieradz to King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia' (Wenceslaus II had obtained the Seniorate Duchy of Kraków in 1291); infobox 'Ruled by Bohemia: 1299'.
1306: 'upon the extinction of the Bohemian Přemyslid dynasty in 1306' Sieradz returned to Poland as a vassal duchy; Władysław I the Elbow-high rules again (1306-1327).
1339: 'after 1339 incorporated by King Casimir III the Great' into the Lands of the Polish Crown as the Sieradz Voivodeship.
1339: the last duke, Przemysł of Inowrocław (1327-1339), is followed by the Polish Crown; the duchy becomes the Sieradz Voivodeship.

certainty.note: Neither page gives a boundary; the duchy is known as the later Sieradz Voivodeship.
